title: Quaest Poll: 60% of Brazilians Reject Flávio Bolsonaro as Right's Best 2026 Candidate
detail: A Quaest poll finds 60% of Brazilians do not view Flávio Bolsonaro as the right's best 2026 presidential candidate, while 46% do not consider Lula the left's best option—signalling broad voter dissatisfaction ahead of October 2026 elections.
